item.title: Pritzker, Bailey set for Illinois governor showdown in November
item.description: JB Pritzker and Darren Bailey will face off in the November election for Illinois Governor, with Pritzker seeking a third term and Bailey promising to focus on Chicago and lower costs.

item.title: Lollapalooza reveals full 2026 lineup
item.description: Lollapalooza has released the official 2026 lineup for this summer's music festival, taking place at Chicago's Grant Park from July 30 to August 2.

item.title: Cubs' Seiya Suzuki diagnosed with a sprained PCL
item.description: Seiya Suzuki, the Chicago Cubs' slugging outfielder, suffered a strained posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) injury while playing for Team Japan in the World Baseball Classic, but the Cubs are optimistic about his recovery and will wait until the weekend before Opening Day to decide if he will be available to start the regular season.

item.title: Teen dies after being shot in head on Far South Side
item.description: A teen has died after being shot in the head Tuesday evening on the Far South Side.

item.title: Chicago firefighter dies after suffering critical injuries while battling blaze on Far North Side
item.description: Michael Altman, a 32-year-old Chicago firefighter, tragically died after being critically injured while battling a fire on the city's Far North Side on Monday.
